title: Strong ill-posedness of the 2D Boussinesq equations in supercritical Besov spaces
summary: In this paper, we prove that the 2D Boussinesq equations are strongly ill-posed in the supercritical Besov spaces $B^s_{p,q}$ and Sobolev spaces $W^{s,p}$ with $(p,q)\in(1,\infty)\times [1,\infty]$ and $s\in(0,1+2/p)$ by constructing an initial data with arbitrarily small norm for which the solution of the system exhibits norm inflation almost instantaneously. As a further application, we prove the instability of perturbations near the hydrostatic equilibrium for the 2D Boussinesq equations in the same $B^s_{p,q}$ and $W^{s,p}$.
